4875-5686-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
4875-5686-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

628-728-6972.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken non-Human creature with base toughness 2 or greater.
628-728-6972.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another nontoken non-Human creature
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Grimgrin abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
628-728-6972.notes: If the creature being used starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

222-527-4247-4927.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4247-4927.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1671-2292-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Simic Growth Chamber.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Simic Growth Chamber from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability
Repeat.

1409-1753-3099-6006.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

215-5295-5457.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven creatures with different powers.
215-5295-5457.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-5295-5457.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {W}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Selvala

5147-5170-6132-7452.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

5330-6871-6879-7223.description:
Cast Stalactite Dagger by paying {2}.
When Stalactite Dagger enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Shapeshifter creature token with changeling.
When the Shapeshifter enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Stalactite Dagger, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Atog by sacrificing Stalactite Dagger.
When Stalactite Dagger dies, Haru triggers, returning Stalactite Dagger from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 once.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat from step 4.

630-2366-4927-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
630-2366-4927-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Keeper of Progenitus triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

250-779-1479-5414-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5414-5702.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Springheart Nantuko and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1003-2511-4053-6989.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

141-997-6819.description:
Cast Vincent's Limit Break by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Vincent's Limit Break, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Vincent's Limit Break.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Woe Strider abilities from step 5.

997-3234-3293-5413.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
997-3234-3293-5413.description:
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat
997-3234-3293-5413.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

24-1330-4090.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}, choosing an arbitrarily large number and having Wheel of Misfortune deal that much damage to Truefire Captain instead of you due to Pariah if you chose the largest number.
Truefire Captain triggers, dealing that much damage to an applicable target.
24-1330-4090.notes: If you didn't choose the highest number, Wheel of Misfortune will deal damage to the opponent(s) who did equal to that number.

478-3573-6871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
478-3573-6871.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding {U} for each artifact you control.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Tolarian Academy and Candelabra of Tawnos as it is a land due to Toph.
Repeat.

2232-3680-6749.easyPrerequisites: You control six or more lands.
2232-3680-6749.description:
Cast Stunt Double by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
When Stunt Double enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Anticausal Vestige from the battlefield to your hand.
When Anticausal Vestige leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and and put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Anticausal Vestige enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Stunt Double from the battlefield to your hand.
When Stunt Double leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Stunt Double from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
Repeat from step 2.

1086-2034-3000-4593.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Anointer Priest triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
1086-2034-3000-4593.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

325-2498-4067-6282.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have at least one card in hand.
325-2498-4067-6282.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card.
Toluz's second ability triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Sheoldred triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

1339-2034-2122-4435.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw two cards.
The Locust God triggers twice, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability twice by paying {2} and discarding two cards, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

3875-4693-5531-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least two lands between the battlefield and your graveyard.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
3875-4693-5531-5702.description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 3 until you control no lands.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Lumra.
Put the token Lumra into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Tireless Provisioner trigger that many times.
Resolve all Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating at least two Treasure tokens, and then an additional Clue or Treasure token for each remaining trigger.
Holding priority, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve all but one Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating that many 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

1409-2724-3080-5299.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U}{U} the first turn with {1}{U} each extra turn
1409-2724-3080-5299.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Exchange of Words trigger, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and Exchange of Words.
Activate Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Exchange of Words leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering the second ability it gained from Wormfang Manta's textbox as well as its own ability and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the first Exchange of Words trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the second Exchange of Words trigger, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Exchange of Words.
Repeat from step 5 during each turn.

1117-3689-4659-5705.notablePrerequisites:
One of the artifact creatures must be in your hand while the other is in your graveyard.
You have enough mana to cast the artifact card in your hand.
1117-3689-4659-5705.description:
Cast the artifact creature card in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the artifact creature spell, triggering Glaring Fleshraker's second ability, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the artifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the artifact creature dies, it triggers, returning the other artifact creature from your graveyard to your hand.
If needed, activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

4740-5078-5243-5313.manaNeeded: {2} minus {1} for each 3 life you have and minus {1} if your storm count is 2 or greater
4740-5078-5243-5313.easyPrerequisites: The Reality Chip attached to a creature you control.
4740-5078-5243-5313.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
If needed, activate Treasonous Ogre by paying 3 life, adding {R}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Repeat.

1322-2457-3129-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

101-225-565-1987.notablePrerequisites:
You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
101-225-565-1987.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting Vampire Charmseeker and the mana-producing land.
Orvar triggers, creating a copy of the mana-producing land.
When the land token enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers.
Holding priority, activate the nontoken land by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate the nontoken land by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger from step 3, untapping it.
Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking the land and Vampire Charmseeker.
When the land and Vampire Charmseeker enter the battlefield, Vampire Charmseeker and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land token.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger from step 8, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
101-225-565-1987.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may cast Ghostly Flicker targeting any other permanent(s).

1636-3143-5696-6173.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1636-3143-5696-6173.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Prowling Felidar trigger.
Resolve the Prowling Felidar trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2457-4231-4321-5794.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token, a Food token, a Clue token and a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Activate Baylen's first ability by tapping two tokens, adding {1}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite untapped tokens, you may tap them for infinite mana and forego sacrificing the Treasures, and/or use Baylen's other abilities.

uses.n: Ojer Axonil, Deepest Might // Temple of Power

2868-4050-5551.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
2868-4050-5551.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Axonil that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Lazotep Convert, adding one mana of any color.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Axonil that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Repeat from step 4.

586-2921-5011-5406.notablePrerequisites: Cavalier of Night exiled by Dinosaur Headdress.
586-2921-5011-5406.description:
Activate Dinosaur Headdress' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to Priest of Gix and causing Priest of Gix to become a copy of Cavalier of Night.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, its second ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Cavalier of Night

1430-5011-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Mirror Image.
When Mirror Image dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Mirror Image enters the battlefield, its first triggered ability from Cavalier of Night triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Repeat.

102-678-2452.description:
Cast Graf Reaver by paying {0}.
When Graf Reaver enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Graf Reaver dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning it to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

2829-3363-4935.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast a spell this turn.
2829-3363-4935.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing The One Ring, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Ravager.
Activate Conduit of Worlds by tapping it, causing you to pay {4} to cast The One Ring from your graveyard.
The One Ring triggers, giving you protection from everything until your next turn.
Repeat during each of your turns.

538-1407-2615.description:
Activate Dollhouse of Horrors by paying {1}, tapping it and exiling Tree of Perdition from your graveyard, creating a token copy of Tree of Perdition that is a 0/0 Construct with haste.
The Tree of Perdition copy enters the battlefield, triggering Impact Tremors.
Holding priority, activate the Tree of Perdition copy by tapping it, exchanging its toughness with target opponent's life total.
Resolve the Impact Tremors trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
The opponent whose life total was swapped loses the game due to having zero or les life.

331-878-3059.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Ziatora triggers, causing you to sacrifice Malignus, deal damage equal to two times Malignus's power to target opponent, and create three Treasure tokens.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

3110-4934-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Amareth triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Amareth trigger, causing you to look at the top card of your library, which will be Sensei's Divining Top, and put it into your hand.
Repeat.
